title: Mt. Sinai, Sinai Peninsula, Egypt, 2011 — man riding a camel
summary: A photo of a man in a white T-shirt riding a camel along a rocky desert path near Mt. Sinai, captioned Mt. Sinai, Sinai Peninsula, Egypt, 2011.

pictures.description: Colour photograph of a man with glasses, in a white T-shirt and jeans, seated on a camel with a striped, colourful saddle blanket. They are on a stony desert track between rocky brown mountains under a blue sky; another camel and rider are further down the path and the camel's long shadow falls across the ground in front.
